data.name: Revint Operational Intelligence
data.description: Revint is the karar/sicaklik/aksiyon (intelligence + action) layer that sits on top of HubSpot. It pulls fresh CRM signals via webhooks, runs lead analysis (sub-niche, review, audit, scorer), writes the canonical `revint_*` custom contact properties back, and surfaces a record-side App Card so the SDR can answer one question fast: 'What do I do with this lead right now?'
